name: bringup-boot-ready
about: Bring-up matrix row boot/ready: after the strict ready gate, re-read the golden handshake page, boot state, exception mask and exception staging word, and gate the ready handshake through both the direct reader and rd_catalog. Read-only: NO H2D message is fired, so this is the safe first session on any new image.

steps.name: boot-readback
steps.about: golden handshake page (CA 0x1BF000), boot state (CA 0x118B60), exception mask (CA 0x40008) and exception staging word (CA 0x4000C)

steps.name: ready-direct
steps.about: direct device group-A reader: id1 + id2 and the id2 payload = the vendor device-RAM ring-pointer table (data-plane seed)

steps.name: ready-phase
steps.about: the vendor post-ready phase before any H2D message

steps.name: catalog
steps.about: boot D2H catalogue still carries the ready pair (captured for the matrix row)

steps.name: note
steps.about: read-only row: no H2D frame is posted; any g1 response seen here belongs to a firmware-unsolicited event family
